raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Support metadata-only image EPD for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash so P/D can skip duplicate image preprocessing. Related to #52409.

## Claims

- Publish `llm_grid` through the existing EC metadata protocol and reconstruct identical image placeholder spans on the consumer.
- Accept image embedding references in the DeepSeek chat template while preserving image ordering and the raw-image path.

## Validation

GB200, PR `29e15453b1e4` (main `f1df4a3ae95e`), 2E (TP1 each) + PD (TP2), Mooncake RDMA, Model Runner V2 and CUDA Graphs. Same 512 task-stratified MUIRBench questions, concurrency 96. Each path used freshly started E/PD/proxy services, the same 1,736 synthetic-image warmup requests (disjoint from evaluation data), and one measured pass. Caches remained enabled.

| Metric | Raw images | Metadata-only | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Total token/s | 17,645 | 19,618 | +11.19% |
| token/s/GPU | 4,411 | 4,905 | +11.19% |
| Mean E2E latency | 10.40 s | 9.30 s | -10.62% |
| P90 E2E latency | 12.41 s | 11.58 s | -6.68% |
| Accuracy | 62.11% (318/512) | 61.91% (317/512) | -0.20 pp |

All 1,024 requests succeeded; input/output token counts matched, no runtime JIT was detected, and every metadata-path request was rewritten. Throughput counts input + actual output tokens; per-GPU throughput divides by all four GPUs.

<details>
<summary>Previously run test commands</summary>

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_deepseek_v4_vl.py \
  tests/tokenizers_/test_deepseek_v41.py

.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/ec_connector/unit/test_epd_proxy_retry.py \
  tests/v1/ec_connector/unit/test_ec_example_connector.py
```

Passed 50 and 74 tests respectively.

</details>

## Details

Reuses existing EC transport and metadata parsing; no proxy, scheduler, or model-runner changes. An image span contains `h * (w + 1) + 2` positions, so `llm_grid` is sufficient without pixels or layout tensors.

Open-PR searches found no duplicate EC implementation. #61418 instead optimizes routing metadata from source images for `/render`.

AI assistance was used.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@@ -65,3 +83,175 @@ def test_get_image_size_with_most_features_respects_max_wh_ratio():

+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sizes", [[(224, 224)], [(336, 560), (840, 224), (336, 560)]])
+def test_v41_image_metadata_only_roundtrip(sizes, monkeypatch):
+    """EC metadata preserves image spans without running image preprocessing."""
+    ctx = build_model_context(
+        "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash",
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": len(sizes)},
+    )
+    mm_config = ctx.model_config.multimodal_config
+    mm_config.enable_mm_embeds = True
+    mm_config.allow_missing_mm_embeddings = True
+    processor = MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.create_processor(ctx.model_config)
+    images = [Image.new("RGB", size) for size in sizes]
+    prompt = processor.dummy_inputs.get_dummy_text({"image": len(images)})
+    raw = processor(
+        prompt,
+        mm_items=processor.info.parse_mm_data({"image": images}),
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs={},
+    )
+    features = [
+        MultiModalFeatureSpec(
+            data=item,
+            modality="image",
+            identifier=raw["mm_hashes"]["image"][index],
+            mm_position=position,
+        )
+        for index, (item, position) in enumerate(
+            zip(raw["mm_kwargs"]["image"], raw["mm_placeholders"]["image"])
+        )
+    ]

+    )

+        json.dumps([published[feature.identifier]["metadata"] for feature in features])
+    )
+    assert all(set(item) == {"llm_grid"} for item in metadata)
+    renderer = DeepseekV41Renderer.__new__(DeepseekV41Renderer)
+    renderer.model_config = ctx.model_config
+    renderer.mm_processor = processor
+    renderer.tokenizer = get_deepseek_v41_tokenizer(processor.info.get_tokenizer())
+    _, rendered = renderer.render_messages(

+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "image_embeds", "image_embeds": item, "uuid": str(i)}
+                    for i, item in enumerate(metadata)
+                ],
+            }

+    )
+    prompt_data = cast(DecoderOnlyDictPrompt, rendered)
+    assert prompt_data["multi_modal_uuids"]["image"] == [
+        str(i) for i in range(len(sizes))
+    ]
+    mm_data = prompt_data["multi_modal_data"]
+    assert mm_data is not None
+    image_data = mm_data["image"]
+    assert isinstance(image_data, dict)
+
+    def unexpected_preprocessing(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("The EC consumer must not preprocess images")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(processor, "_call_hf_processor", unexpected_preprocessing)
+    remote = processor(
+        prompt,
+        mm_items=processor.info.parse_mm_data({"image": image_data}),
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs={},
+    )
+    assert remote["prompt_token_ids"] == raw["prompt_token_ids"]
+    assert remote["mm_placeholders"] == raw["mm_placeholders"]
+    remote_data = remote["mm_kwargs"].get_data()
+    assert set(remote_data) == {"llm_grid"}
+    assert torch.equal(remote_data["llm_grid"], raw["mm_kwargs"].get_data()["llm_grid"])
+
+    mm_config.allow_missing_mm_embeddings = False
+    ordinary_processor = MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.create_processor(ctx.model_config)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="should contain the fields"):
+        ordinary_processor.info.parse_mm_data({"image": image_data})
+
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41 import DeepseekV41ForCausalLM
+
+    assert DeepseekV41ForCausalLM.get_placeholder_str(
+        "image_embeds", 0
+    ) == DeepseekV41ForCausalLM.get_placeholder_str("image", 0)
+    lengths = [position.length for position in raw["mm_placeholders"]["image"]]
+    embeddings = torch.randn(sum(lengths), ctx.model_config.hf_config.hidden_size)
+    supplied = ordinary_processor(
+        prompt,
+        mm_items=ordinary_processor.info.parse_mm_data(
+            {"image": {**image_data, "image_embeds": embeddings}}
+        ),
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs={},
+    )
+    model = DeepseekV41ForCausalLM.__new__(
+        DeepseekV41ForCausalLM  # type: ignore[type-abstract]
+    )
+    outputs = model.embed_multimodal(**supplied["mm_kwargs"].get_data())
+    assert supplied["prompt_token_ids"] == raw["prompt_token_ids"]
+    assert [len(output) for output in outputs] == lengths
+    assert torch.equal(torch.cat(outputs), embeddings)
+
+
+def test_v41_renderer_keeps_metadata_when_image_order_is_unchanged():
+    """Unchanged image order must not require parsing or rebuilding metadata."""
+    renderer = DeepseekV41Renderer.__new__(DeepseekV41Renderer)
+    image_data = {"llm_grid": torch.tensor([[2, 3], [3, 2]])}
+    image_uuids = ["first", "second"]
+    prompt = cast(
+        DecoderOnlyDictPrompt,
+        renderer._build_prompt(
+            ("prompt", [0, 1]), {"image": image_data}, {"image": image_uuids}
+        ),
+    )
+    mm_data = prompt["multi_modal_data"]
+    assert mm_data is not None
+    assert mm_data["image"] is image_data
+    assert prompt["multi_modal_uuids"]["image"] is image_uuids
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "image_order", [[2, 1, 0], [0, 2]], ids=["reversed", "dropped"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "with_embeddings", [False, True], ids=["metadata", "embeddings"]
+)
+def test_v41_renderer_keeps_reordered_image_data_aligned(image_order, with_embeddings):
+    """Reordering images must keep their grids, UUIDs and embedding slices aligned."""
+    ctx = build_model_context(
+        "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 3}
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(model_config=ctx.model_config)
+    mm_config = ctx.model_config.multimodal_config
+    assert mm_config is not None
+    mm_config.enable_mm_embeds = True
+    mm_config.allow_missing_mm_embeddings = not with_embeddings
+    renderer = DeepseekV41Renderer(
+        config, get_deepseek_v41_tokenizer(ctx.get_tokenizer())
+    )
+    try:
+        grids = torch.tensor([[2, 3], [3, 2], [1, 4]])
+        image_data = {"llm_grid": grids}
+        lengths = [num_image_tokens(h, w) for h, w in grids.tolist()]
+        embeddings = torch.arange(
+            sum(lengths) * ctx.model_config.hf_config.hidden_size, dtype=torch.float32
+        ).reshape(sum(lengths), -1)
+        if with_embeddings:
+            image_data["image_embeds"] = embeddings
+        uuids = ["first", "second", "third"]
+        prompt = cast(
+            DecoderOnlyDictPrompt,
+            renderer._build_prompt(
+                ("prompt", image_order), {"image": image_data}, {"image": uuids}
+            ),
+        )
+        mm_data = prompt["multi_modal_data"]
+        assert mm_data is not None
+        reordered = mm_data["image"]
+        assert isinstance(reordered, dict)
+        assert set(reordered) == set(image_data)
+        assert torch.equal(reordered["llm_grid"], grids[image_order])
+        assert prompt["multi_modal_uuids"]["image"] == [uuids[i] for i in image_order]
+        if with_embeddings:
+            slices = embeddings.split(lengths)
+            assert torch.equal(
+                reordered["image_embeds"], torch.cat([slices[i] for i in image_order])
+            )
+    finally:
+        renderer.shutdown()
